points.title: 童年与教育
points.description: 纳吉布·马哈福兹出生于开罗杰马利亚区的一个中产阶级家庭。他的父亲是公务员，母亲受过良好教育。马哈福兹在开罗的伊斯兰学校接受基础教育，后进入开罗大学学习哲学。这段时期，他深受埃及民族主义思潮影响，同时广泛阅读阿拉伯和西方文学，为日后的创作奠定了基础。开罗的多元文化环境和社会变革成为他早期作品的重要灵感来源。
points.descriptionEn: Naguib Mahfouz was born in the Gamaliya district of Cairo to a middle-class family. His father was a civil servant and his mother was well-educated. Mahfouz received his primary education at an Islamic school before studying philosophy at Cairo University. During this period, he was deeply influenced by Egyptian nationalist movements and extensively read Arabic and Western literature, laying the foundation for his future writing. Cairo's multicultural environment and social changes became important sources of inspiration for his early works.

points.title: 公务员与早期创作
points.description: 大学毕业后，马哈福兹进入埃及政府部门工作，在宗教捐赠部、财政部等多个部门任职，直至1971年退休。在公务员生涯期间，他坚持文学创作，发表了多部短篇小说集和长篇小说。这一时期，他的作品主要关注埃及社会问题，如贫困、不公和传统与现代的冲突。1945年发表的《新开罗》标志着他创作风格的成熟，开始探索埃及社会的复杂现实。开罗的城市生活成为他创作的重要背景和主题。
points.descriptionEn: After graduating from university, Mahfouz began a career as a civil servant in various Egyptian government departments, including the Ministry of Religious Endowments and the Ministry of Finance, until his retirement in 1971. During his civil service career, he continued to write, publishing numerous short story collections and novels. During this period, his works primarily focused on Egyptian social issues such as poverty, injustice, and the conflict between tradition and modernity. His 1945 novel 'New Cairo' marked the maturation of his writing style, as he began to explore the complexities of Egyptian society. Cairo's urban life became a significant backdrop and theme in his work.

points.title: 代表作三部曲
points.description: 1956-1957年间，马哈福兹创作了被誉为阿拉伯文学巅峰之作的《开罗三部曲》，包括《宫间街》《思宫街》和《甘露街》。这部宏大的家族史诗以1917年至1944年的埃及社会为背景，通过一个开罗中产阶级家族三代人的命运变迁，展现了埃及从英国殖民统治到独立后的社会变革。这部作品确立了马哈福兹在阿拉伯文学界的地位，也为他赢得了国际声誉。三部曲的出版正值埃及革命后，反映了当时埃及社会的集体记忆和民族认同。
points.descriptionEn: Between 1956 and 1957, Mahfouz wrote his 'Cairo Trilogy'—'Palace Walk,' 'Palace of Desire,' and 'Sugar Street'—considered the pinnacle of Arabic literature. This epic family saga, set against the backdrop of Egyptian society from 1917 to 1944, portrays the changing fortunes of three generations of a middle-class Cairo family, illustrating Egypt's social transformation from British colonial rule to post-independence. This work established Mahfouz's position in Arabic literature and brought him international acclaim. Published shortly after the Egyptian Revolution, the trilogy reflected the collective memory and national identity of Egyptian society at the time.

points.title: 诺贝尔文学奖
points.description: 1988年，马哈福兹成为第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖的阿拉伯作家。瑞典学院授予他该奖项，以表彰他'通过作品对人类处境进行了深刻洞察，尤其是对阿拉伯生活的戏剧性描述'。颁奖典礼上，马哈福兹发表演讲，强调文学作为人类共同遗产的重要性。这一荣誉不仅提升了马哈福兹个人的国际声誉，也使阿拉伯文学和埃及文化获得了全球关注，促进了东西方文学交流。然而，由于对萨达姆·侯赛因批评言论的争议，马哈福兹在埃及国内曾面临一些抵制。
points.descriptionEn: In 1988, Mahfouz became the first Arabic writer to be awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature. The Swedish Academy honored him 'for works rich in nuance that address the human condition in the world of the Arabs.' At the award ceremony, Mahfouz delivered a speech emphasizing the importance of literature as a common human heritage. This honor not only enhanced Mahfouz's international reputation but also brought global attention to Arabic literature and Egyptian culture, promoting East-West literary exchange. However, due to controversial remarks criticizing Saddam Hussein, Mahfouz faced some backlash in Egypt.

points.title: 晚年创作与影响
points.description: 1994年，马哈福兹在开罗遭遇一次未遂的暗杀，导致右臂永久性损伤，这严重影响了他的写作能力。尽管如此，他仍继续创作短篇小说和随笔，直到去世。晚年，他更多地关注宗教与哲学问题，同时积极参与埃及公共事务，表达对社会和政治问题的看法。马哈福兹的作品被翻译成多种语言，影响了几代作家和读者。他被视为阿拉伯现代文学的奠基人，其作品成为理解现代阿拉伯社会的重要窗口。2006年，马哈福兹在开罗逝世，享年94岁，被安葬于当地清真寺。
points.descriptionEn: In 1994, Mahfouz survived an assassination attempt in Cairo that permanently damaged his right arm, severely affecting his ability to write. Despite this, he continued to write short stories and essays until his death. In his later years, he focused more on religious and philosophical issues while actively participating in Egyptian public affairs, expressing his views on social and political matters. Mahfouz's works have been translated into numerous languages, influencing generations of writers and readers. He is regarded as a founder of modern Arabic literature, and his works serve as an important window to understanding modern Arab society. Mahfouz died in Cairo in 2006 at the age of 94 and was buried in a local mosque.

appraisal.zh: 马哈福兹被公认为阿拉伯现代文学的巨匠，其三部曲既是文学里程碑，也是研究20世纪埃及社会史的重要史料，并被多次改编为影视，成为连接阿拉伯传统与现代、东方与西方的重要桥梁。也有研究者指出，他对女性角色的刻画偏于刻板保守，对社会问题的描写过于悲观，政治立场亦有摇摆，艺术创新未完全突破阿拉伯文学传统框架。
appraisal.en: Mahfouz is recognized as a giant of modern Arabic literature: his trilogy is both a literary milestone and an important source for studying 20th-century Egyptian society, has been repeatedly adapted for film and television, and serves as a bridge between Arab tradition and modernity, East and West. Yet some researchers note that his female characters are stereotypical and conservative, his depiction of social problems overly pessimistic, his political stances shifting, and his artistic innovation never fully broke through the traditional framework of Arabic literature.

supporter.zh: 马哈福兹被誉为阿拉伯文学的巨匠，他的作品深刻反映了埃及社会的变迁，为阿拉伯文学赢得了国际声誉。支持者认为他通过文学创作促进了阿拉伯世界的自我认知和文化自信，他的三部曲被视为阿拉伯现代文学的里程碑。马哈福兹坚持用阿拉伯语写作，为现代阿拉伯语文学的发展做出了不可磨灭的贡献，他的作品跨越了政治和宗教的界限，成为人类共同的文化遗产。
supporter.en: Mahfouz is hailed as a giant of Arabic literature, whose works profoundly reflect the transformations of Egyptian society and earned Arabic literature international acclaim. Supporters argue that through his literary creations, he enhanced the Arab world's self-awareness and cultural confidence, with his trilogy regarded as a milestone in modern Arabic literature. By persisting in writing in Arabic, Mahfouz made indelible contributions to the development of modern Arabic literature, and his works transcend political and religious boundaries, becoming a common cultural heritage of humanity.

critic.zh: 批评者指出马哈福兹的作品存在局限性，尤其是对女性角色的刻画常被批评为刻板和保守。一些评论家认为他对埃及社会问题的描述过于悲观，缺乏建设性解决方案。此外，他在政治立场上的摇摆也受到质疑，尤其是对纳赛尔和萨达姆等政治人物的态度变化。批评者还认为，尽管他获得了诺贝尔奖，但他的作品在艺术创新上不如同时期的西方作家激进，未能完全突破阿拉伯文学的传统框架。
critic.en: Critics point out limitations in Mahfouz's work, particularly his portrayal of female characters, which is often criticized as stereotypical and conservative. Some commentators argue that his depiction of Egyptian social problems is overly pessimistic and lacks constructive solutions. Additionally, his shifting political stances, especially his changing attitudes toward figures like Nasser and Saddam Hussein, have been questioned. Critics also suggest that despite his Nobel Prize, his works are less artistically innovative than those of contemporary Western writers and did not fully break through the traditional framework of Arabic literature.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，马哈福兹已成为阿拉伯现代文学的代表人物，其作品被纳入世界文学经典。他的三部曲不仅是文学杰作，也是研究20世纪埃及社会史的重要史料。在流行文化中，他的故事多次被改编为电影和电视剧，影响了阿拉伯世界的影视创作。马哈福兹的生平和创作反映了阿拉伯知识分子在现代化进程中的挣扎与思考，他的作品成为连接阿拉伯传统与现代、东方与西方文化的重要桥梁，在全球化背景下持续发挥着文化影响力。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Mahfouz has become a representative figure of modern Arabic literature, with his works included in the canon of world literature. His trilogy is not only a literary masterpiece but also an important historical source for studying 20th-century Egyptian society. In popular culture, his stories have been adapted into films and television series multiple times, influencing audiovisual production in the Arab world. Mahfouz's life and work reflect the struggles and reflections of Arab intellectuals in the process of modernization, and his works serve as an important bridge connecting Arab tradition with modernity and Eastern with Western cultures, continuing to exert cultural influence in the context of globalization.

self.zh: 文学是人类共同遗产的一部分，它超越国界，将人们团结在一起。
self.en: Literature is part of the common human heritage that transcends borders and unites people.
